models.label: Llama-3.2-1B
models.note: Small Llama variant — LoRA modules are compact despite the 1B-param base.

models.label: distilgpt2
models.note: Smallest tested model. Proof time near identical to Llama-3.2-1B: circuit size tracks LoRA matrix dimensions, not base-model size.

models.label: gpt2
models.note: Double the LoRA module size of distilgpt2 (49k vs 24k params) — proof time rises by just 10%, consistent with roughly log-linear scaling.

models.label: Llama-3.3-70B
models.note: Frontier 70B model — 80 LoRA modules. Per-module proof time lower than Llama-3.1-8B because per-layer attention dimensions differ; full-adapter set takes ~63 min sequentially.

models.label: Llama-3.1-8B
models.note: Largest per-module LoRA among the non-MoE models (163k params). Proof time slightly exceeds 70B because module matrix dimensions are wider here.

models.label: Mixtral-8x7B
models.note: MoE model: 8 experts per layer, larger per-module matrices (327k params). Proof generation is slowest at 73.7 s/module — 2.4× slower than Llama-3.2-1B.

source: ZKLoRA, Roy et al., arXiv:2501.13965, Table 1 — averaged over LoRA modules per model.
